name: hr-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Croatia for 2026, in euro. Covers the limited liability company (d.o.o.), the simplified limited liability company (j.d.o.o.) and the joint-stock company (d.d.); minimum share capital (EUR 2,500, EUR 1 and EUR 25,000), the minimum share and how much must be paid in before registration; the j.d.o.o. legal reserve; notarial, remote and START formation; registration at the commercial court register and its five-working-day decision period; the 2026 court register fees; the OIB; the euro alignment of older companies; annual financial statements to FINA (30 April and six months) and the fine for missing them; and the first profit tax steps (PD return by 30 April, monthly advances). Trigger phrases: register a company in Croatia, d.o.o., j.d.o.o., sudski registar, temeljni kapital, FINA GFI. Out of scope: profit tax computation (hr-corporate-income-tax), VAT (croatia-vat-return), payroll (croatia-payroll).
